links.comparator_used: Alert logic as initially deployed, tracked over 16 months of iterative modification (no unchanged-alert control arm)
links.outcome: Alert firing frequency and rate of alert dismissal without orders placed after iterative changes to alert logic
links.effect: Alert firing rose from 53.8 per 1,000 patient days in the first 6 months to 61 per 1,000 patient days in the final 6 months; dismissal without action stayed at 88% with no significant decrease
links.tradeoff: Repeated modifications were needed and negative user feedback continued; the 'wrong person' receiving the alert accounted for nearly 50% of negative feedback despite logic limiting firing to the primary team
links.quote: Modifications also did not cause a significant decrease in how frequently the alert was dismissed without further action being taken (88%).

design_hint: silent-mode testing and iterative post-deployment alert logic refinement
